document_metadata.title: Ethiopian National Digital Education Strategy & SchoolNet ICT Architecture
document_metadata.issuing_authority: FDRE Ministry of Education - ICT and Digital Education Executive

strategic_vision: Creating a digitally enabled national educational ecosystem that eliminates geographic barriers to quality learning, equips Ethiopian youth with 21st-century technological competencies, and modernizes school management through data-driven governance.

objectives: Connect all secondary schools and teacher training colleges to broadband high-speed fiber-optic and satellite internet.
Equip remote rural schools with off-grid solar power generators to support computer laboratory servers.
Establish localized offline intranet caching servers (Zero-Rated Local Area Networks) enabling textbook access without internet bandwidth.

core_strategic_pillars.pillar_name: National Digital Curriculum, Cloud Repository & E-Learning Portals
objectives: Digitize all KG-12 student textbooks and teacher guides into interactive EPUB, PDF, and audio formats.
Deploy the National Cloud Learning Management System (National LMS) hosting interactive STEM simulations and video lectures.
Translate core digital learning content into major national languages (Afaan Oromoo, Amharic, Tigrinya, Somali, Sidama).

core_strategic_pillars.pillar_name: Smart Classrooms & Secondary Student Device Deployment
objectives: Distribute ruggedized student e-learning tablets pre-loaded with digital textbooks and assessment software to secondary schools.
Install interactive smart digital displays and projection units in high school science and mathematics laboratories.
Facilitate secure computer laboratories in all public universities to host computerized national entrance and exit examinations.

core_strategic_pillars.pillar_name: Teacher ICT Competency & Digital Pedagogical Training
core_strategic_pillars.lead_executive: Teachers and Educational Leaders Development Desk
core_strategic_pillars.framework_standard: UNESCO-Aligned Ethiopian Teacher ICT Competency Framework

proficiency_levels.target: Basic computer operation, digital presentation tools, and internet research.
Integrating digital simulations in STEM lessons and continuous formative digital assessment.
Designing localized open educational resources (OER) and collaborating on teacher networks.

core_strategic_pillars.lead_executive: Network Technical and Network Operation Desk
objectives: Transition from annual paper surveys to real-time cloud-based Student Information Management Systems (SIMS).
Assign a unique national National Student Identification Number (NSIN) linked to federal digital ID (Fayda).
Enable automated tracking of teacher deployment, textbook distribution, school infrastructure deficits, and student attendance.

system_specifications.platform_architecture: Centralized Cloud Database with Regional Edge Synchronization
system_specifications.data_security: AES-256 Encryption at Rest, Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
system_specifications.annual_statistical_automation: Automated generation of Education Statistics Annual Abstract (ESAA)
